shared_elements: more than one animal facing the same direction, arranged in a row
justification: Both surfaces show quadrupeds in profile aligned in the same direction along a horizontal register, which is about as generic as animal iconography gets. B additionally has human attendants touching and leading horned rams rendered with naturalistic modelling, fleece texture and curling horns, while A is a purely schematic outline drawing of stick-legged, comb-like bodies with no discernible heads, horns or human figures.
